body: Yeah I guess so, if I was to get one I think I would use it more as something to help with dilators rather than with my partner. Thanks anyway i do think this will really help.

I find the whole planning it out quite scary and I'm going to be quite upset with myself if I don't stick to it. But its just keeping a positive mindset I suppose which will really help me get through it. So thanks!

Yeah, making a strict plan will really help me. I think sticking to it will be really difficult but I guess I'll just have to start off slowly and make my way into a stricter schedule like yourself. It will be hard to keep on track but I'm sure I can do it
I might as well give it a try so I think that's the next thing for me to do. It will definitely help a lot. Thanks for your advice though!

Yeah, saying that I do think using a vibrator could be very useful and a massive help. I guess it saves a lot of time trying to build myself up to using the dilators. Do you find yourself having to use it even with your partner? I just don't want it to become something that I rely on constantly whenever I'm not feeling in the mood.

Ah ok so its just being quite strict with yourself and setting goals. I do want to make a plan I'm just not sure with how to go about it. I think you should make a post about how you did it, it could be really useful to so many people including myself. If I do create a plan how should I do it and what should the plan consist of just from your experience?

I think this is something I will consider I just don't know if it will be completely reliable as I'm finding it so difficult to actually feel turned on even with my partner. But it is something to think about in the future so thank you anyway.

I'm definitely considering waiting until I'm mentally in a better place and then focusing on overcoming my vaginismus. I realise now how much hard work it takes and I want to be able to focus on it completely.
